[[Duno Dree]], a young [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], flew a '''CR90 corvette''' during a [[Mission to Dorlo|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorlo]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The cinematic introduction of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' shows a CR90 corvette being destroyed by Jerec's forces, when Rahn and his companions are taken captives and executed, suggesting that it was Rahn's transport. The [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent|novelization]] instead mentions a small unnamed transport, piloted by Duno Dree.
